title: Lamb Korma
description: A rich, fragrant lamb curry in a silky yogurt-based sauce — deeply spiced and full of flavour.

method.instruction: Heat vegetable oil in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat. Add diced onion and fry until softened and translucent.
Add ginger paste and garlic paste. Fry for a few seconds until fragrant.
Add bay leaves, cinnamon stick, and dried red chili. Stir briefly.
Add ground cumin, nutmeg, garam masala, and red chili powder. Fry for 30 seconds to release the aromas.
Add lamb pieces. Fry, stirring occasionally, for 3–4 minutes until the meat is well coated and beginning to cook.
Mix yogurt with water until smooth, then add to the curry. Stir well. Season with black pepper and salt.
Cover with a lid, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer until the sauce thickens and the lamb is cooked through and tender, about 30–35 minutes.
Remove bay leaves and cinnamon stick before serving. Serve hot with steamed rice or naan bread.

notes.title: Yogurt Tip
notes.content: Mix the yogurt with water before adding to the pan — this prevents it from splitting when it hits the hot curry. Use room temperature yogurt for the same reason.

notes.title: Recipe Source
notes.content: Adapted from traditional Indian korma recipes.
